title: MZ [Free / Open Source] VegetableDev Community Plugins for RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: VegetableDev
posts.body:
Hiya everyone!
VegetableDev profile:
https://vegey.itch.io/
Welcome to the
VegetableDev Community Plugins
thread!
I’m Vegey, an RPG Maker developer making free community plugins, tutorials, showcases, and small tools for RPG Maker MZ.
This thread will be used as a central place for my free plugin releases, public previews, updates, screenshots, documentation, and community feedback.
The goal is simple:
​
Make useful RPG Maker tools that are easy to use, beginner-friendly, and polished enough to feel like they belong inside a real game.
Click to expand...
All plugins here are part of the VegetableDev community roadmap and follow a two-phase workflow.
Phase 1 — Functionality First
The plugin needs to work reliably before anything else.
That means stable logic, clear parameters, plugin commands, safe behavior across maps and scenes, and avoiding structural bugs.
Phase 2 — Visual Polish
After the system works, the plugin gets a proper presentation pass.
That means cleaner UI, better spacing, animations when useful, visual presets, customization, fallbacks, examples, and documentation.
In other words:
​
It is not enough for a plugin to work. It should feel like it belongs in the game.
Click to expand...

Veg_InteractionBubble v0.8.0
Hiya everyone!
The first VegetableDev community plugin is now available:
Veg_InteractionBubble
Target:
RPG Maker MZ
Version:
v0.8.0-preview
Type:
Interaction / UI / Quality of Life
Status:
Public Preview
Download:
https://vegey.itch.io/interactionbubble
What does it do?
Veg_InteractionBubble
shows small native RPG Maker-style interaction bubbles near events.
For example:
Code:
[E] Talk
[E] Open
[E] Inspect
It is meant to be a simple quality-of-life plugin that makes interactable events easier to read without changing how your project already works.
The plugin works as a
visual layer only
.
It does
not
replace event triggers, movement systems, collision systems, player input, or action battle systems.
Quick Start
Add a
Comment
command to an event page:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Talk>
Walk close to the event, and the bubble will appear.
You can also use:
Code:
<InteractionPrompt: Talk>
<InteractionText: Talk>
Features
Native RPG Maker Window_Base interaction bubbles
Text prompts
Optional button labels
Icons and icon-only prompts
Inline \i[n] icon support
Per-event interaction radius
Per-event priority
Optional facing requirement
Native windowskin support
Per-event windowskin override
Visual presets
Per-event text color and font size overrides
Optional arrow/tail support
Auto flip near screen edges
Target switch delay to reduce flickering
Safe fallbacks for missing assets
Designed as a read-only visual layer
Friendly with pixel movement, dot movement, and 8-direction movement setups
Common Examples
Basic prompt:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Talk>
Different button:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Open>
<InteractionButton: E>
Icon + text:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Open>
<InteractionIcon: 176>
Inline icon:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: \i[82] Inspect>
Icon only:
Code:
<InteractionOnlyIcon: 82>
No button:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Read>
<InteractionButton: none>
Larger radius:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Check>
<InteractionRadius: 2>
Facing required:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Talk>
<InteractionFacing: true>
Higher priority:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Enter>
<InteractionPriority: 10>
Different windowskin:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Save>
<InteractionWindowskin: WindowDark>
Different visual preset:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Talk>
<InteractionPreset: Minimal>
Custom event text color:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Talk>
<InteractionTextColor: #ffeeaa>
Custom event font size:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Talk>
<InteractionFontSize: 18>
Hide the bubble on a specific event page:
Code:
<NoInteractionBubble>
Visual Presets
Default
Uses the project windowskin.
Minimal
Smaller, simpler, and softer.
Pixel
Compact and nice for retro-style projects.
Custom
Uses your plugin parameter settings directly.
Compatibility Notes
This plugin was designed to avoid grid-only assumptions.
In Auto detection mode, it tries to use real/center positions first, then falls back safely for normal RPG Maker movement.
That makes it friendlier with pixel movement, dot movement, and 8-direction movement plugins.
It does not promise perfect compatibility with every plugin ever made, but it tries very hard to stay out of the way.
No HTML, DOM, CSS, document.createElement, or browser UI is used inside the plugin. The bubble is a native RPG Maker Window_Base with normal windowskin behavior.
Terms of Use
This is a free community plugin.
You may use it in free or commercial RPG Maker projects.
Credit is appreciated:
Code:
Interaction Bubble plugin by Vegey / VegetableDev
Please do not sell or redistribute this plugin by itself as your own work.
If you modify it, please keep the original credit somewhere.
Feedback Wanted
This is the first public preview, so feedback is very welcome.
I’m especially interested in:
bug reports
compatibility issues
pixel movement / 8-direction movement tests
UI suggestions
readability issues
screenshots of the plugin in your project
ideas for future presets or polish
Thank you for checking it out.

Veg_InteractionBubble v0.9.0-preview Update
Small patch for
Veg_InteractionBubble
is now available!
This update focuses on better bubble positioning for different sprite sizes.
What changed:
Bubble Offset X/Y and Arrow Offset X/Y now support negative values properly.
Added
Auto Sprite Height
.
Added
Sprite Height Padding
.
Added per-event positioning notetags.
Above Event and Above Player modes now try to place the bubble above the visible sprite/head.
Bottom Center mode is unchanged.
New notetags:
Code:
<InteractionAutoHeight: true>
<InteractionAutoHeight: false>
<InteractionHeightPadding: 8>
Manual positioning still works too:
Code:
<InteractionBubble: Talk>
<InteractionAutoHeight: false>
<InteractionOffsetY: -96>
Download/update here:
https://vegey.itch.io/interactionbubble
Thanks again for the feedback!
